parts.text: Phone photograph inside a furniture showroom: a three-seat fabric sofa in warm grey is the main object, centred, on a light wooden floor with a rug; in the LEFT background, a male staff member in a plain shirt stands facing the camera a few metres behind the sofa, clearly visible but small. Even daylight from large windows on the right, natural colours, no text, no logos, no price tags. 4:3, realistic.
